label: Community health focus
description: Describe a specific Mat-Su community health need the short-format project will address.

scoring.desc: Health need is generic or not tied to Mat-Su.
Need is specific to Mat-Su but lacks supporting data.
Need is specific, data-supported, and aligned with the foundation's focus areas.

common_failures: Focus area not aligned with foundation priorities
No mention of affected population size

label: Short-format clarity
description: For a Target Wellness award under $25,000, deliver a concise, specific, outcome-oriented narrative without boilerplate.

scoring.desc: Narrative is padded with boilerplate or exceeds concise format expectations.
Narrative is concise but one or two sections drift into general language.
Every section is concise, specific, and outcome oriented with minimal boilerplate.

common_failures: Mission-statement filler in the project description

label: Budget reasonableness
description: Present a line-item budget appropriate for a sub-25k project with clear unit costs.

scoring.desc: Budget is a lump sum or mismatched to the scope.
Budget has line items but unit costs are not justified.
Budget ties every line to activities with reasonable unit costs and an appropriate indirect allocation.

common_failures: Indirect rate applied to a program too small to support it

label: Feasibility and timeline
description: Show the project can be completed in the target 12-month window with the requested budget.

scoring.desc: Timeline is vague or exceeds the award period.
Timeline fits the window but milestones are thin.
Timeline has monthly or quarterly milestones and a completion plan.

common_failures: Timeline that spills past the award period
